mapper.select: select home_view from sys_user_home_pref where user_id = #{userId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user_home_pref (id, user_id, tenant_id, home_view, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{homeView}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update home_view = values(home_view), update_time = now()

insert into sys_user_menu_hit (id, user_id, tenant_id, path, title, hit_count, last_hit_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{path}, #{title}, 1, now(), now(), now()) on duplicate key update hit_count = hit_count + 1, title = if(values(title) is null or values(title) = '', title, values(title)), last_hit_time = now(), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select date_format(stk.audit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as dayStr, coalesce(sum(case when stk.bill_type = 101 then ifnull(b.qty, 0) else 0 end), 0) as inCount, coalesce(sum(case when stk.bill_type = 201 then ifnull(b.qty, 0) else 0 end), 0) as outCount, coalesce(sum(case when stk.bill_type = 401 then abs(ifnull(b.qty, 0)) else 0 end), 0) as returnCount from stk_io_bill stk left join stk_io_bill_entry b on b.paren_id = stk.id and (b.del_flag is null or b.del_flag != 1) where (stk.del_flag = 0 or stk.del_flag is null) and stk.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and stk.bill_status = 2 and stk.bill_type in (101, 201, 401) and stk.audit_date >= #{beginDate} and stk.audit_date <= #{endDate} group by date_format(stk.audit_date, '%Y-%m-%d')

select count(1) from dep_purchase_apply dpa where dpa.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (dpa.del_flag = 0 or dpa.del_flag is null) and ifnull(dpa.void_whole_flag, 0) <> 1 and dpa.purchase_bill_status = 2 and ifnull(dpa.purchase_plan_ref_status, 0) in (0, 1)

select count(1) from purchase_order po where po.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and ifnull(po.void_whole_flag, 0) <> 1 and po.order_status = '2' and not exists ( select 1 from stk_io_bill io where io.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (io.del_flag = 0 or io.del_flag is null) and io.bill_type = 101 and io.bill_status = 2 and io.ref_bill_no = po.order_no )

select count(1) from purchase_order po where po.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and ifnull(po.void_whole_flag, 0) <> 1 and po.order_status = '2' and po.expected_delivery_date is not null and date(po.expected_delivery_date) < curdate() and not exists ( select 1 from stk_io_bill io where io.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (io.del_flag = 0 or io.del_flag is null) and io.bill_type = 101 and io.bill_status = 2 and io.ref_bill_no = po.order_no )

select coalesce(sum(case when io.min_audit is not null and date(io.min_audit) <= date(po.expected_delivery_date) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as onTimeCount, count(1) as dueCount from purchase_order po left join ( select ref_bill_no, min(audit_date) as min_audit from stk_io_bill where tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (del_flag = 0 or del_flag is null) and bill_type = 101 and bill_status = 2 and ref_bill_no is not null and ref_bill_no <> '' group by ref_bill_no ) io on io.ref_bill_no = po.order_no where po.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and ifnull(po.void_whole_flag, 0) <> 1 and po.order_status = '2' and po.expected_delivery_date is not null and date(po.expected_delivery_date) >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) and date(po.expected_delivery_date) < curdate()
select count(1) from stk_io_stocktaking stk where stk.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (stk.del_flag is null or stk.del_flag != 1) and stk.stock_type = 501 and ifnull(stk.stock_status, 1) != 2

select count(1) from stk_io_stocktaking_entry e inner join stk_io_stocktaking s on e.paren_id = s.id where e.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and s.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (e.del_flag is null or e.del_flag != 1) and (s.del_flag is null or s.del_flag != 1) and s.stock_type = 501 and s.stock_status = 2 and (s.audit_adjusts_inventory is null or s.audit_adjusts_inventory != 1) and ( (e.profit_qty is not null and e.profit_qty != 0) or (e.profit_amount is not null and e.profit_amount != 0) ) and not exists ( select 1 from stk_io_profit_loss pl where pl.stocktaking_id = s.id and pl.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (pl.del_flag is null or pl.del_flag != 1) )

select count(1) from stk_io_bill stk where stk.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (stk.del_flag is null or stk.del_flag != 1) and stk.bill_type = 501 and ifnull(stk.bill_status, 1) != 2 and stk.bill_no not like 'JS%'

select coalesce(sum(abs(ifnull(e.qty, 0))), 0) from stk_io_bill stk inner join stk_io_bill_entry e on e.paren_id = stk.id and (e.del_flag is null or e.del_flag != 1) where stk.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and (stk.del_flag is null or stk.del_flag != 1) and stk.bill_type = 301 and ifnull(stk.bill_status, 1) != 2

select count(1) from wh_fixed_number fn inner join fd_material m on m.id = fn.material_id left join ( select material_id, warehouse_id, sum(ifnull(qty, 0)) as qty_sum from stk_inventory where (del_flag = 0 or del_flag is null) and tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} group by material_id, warehouse_id ) inv on inv.material_id = fn.material_id and inv.warehouse_id = fn.warehouse_id where (fn.del_flag = 0 or fn.del_flag is null) and (fn.enable_status = '0' or fn.enable_status is null) and fn.tenant_id = #{scopedTenantId} and fn.monitoring = '1' and fn.upper_limit > 0 and coalesce(inv.qty_sum, 0) > fn.upper_limit and (m.del_flag is null or m.del_flag != 1) and (m.is_use is null or m.is_use = '' or m.is_use != '2')
